capabilities: Insert Pandoc-format citations from Zotero or from .bib and CSL JSON files in the vault
Preview citations formatted in a chosen citation style with note-wide context
Show and copy the note's bibliography in a right-sidebar tab
Automatically place citations in footnotes and renumber footnotes in order
Autocomplete citation keys after typing @ and replace keys changed in Zotero
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; beta and previous versions can be installed through the BRAT plugin. Works on mobile and without Zotero by reading bibliography and .csl style files from the vault.
motivation: The author, a Religious Studies scholar, built it for his own research and uses it in teaching a university course on IT in scientific research.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in support for academic citations, so researchers must write Pandoc citation keys and bibliographies by hand.

relations.evidence: cite sources from your Zotero library in Pandoc format
Install the Better BibTeX extension in Zotero — it gives sources their citation keys
when you export with pandoc --citeproc, Quarto or my Pandoc GUI plugin

summary: Academic citation plugin that inserts Pandoc-style citations from Zotero or vault bibliography files, previews formatted citations, and automates footnotes.
